wins.text: Q4 daily sales grew 3.7% YoY, with December up 5.3%, outperforming historical sequential patterns
Q4 EPS of $0.46, up 8.4% from $0.43 in Q4 2022, driven by solid expense discipline
Record full-year operating cash flow of $1.43 billion, up 52% from 2022, driven by working capital reduction
Operating margin of 20.1% in Q4, up 50 bps YoY with 33% incremental margin despite soft growth environment
Warehousing end market grew ~45% in Q4 and ~60% in December, now representing 3%-4% of total sales vs. less than 1% pre-pandemic

risks.text: Sub-50 PMI for 14 consecutive months since November 2022 continues to weigh on industrial end markets; manufacturing customers remain cautious and tight with spending
Fastener product line experienced contraction in both MRO and, for the first time this cycle, OEM products in Q4
Onsite signings of only 58 in Q4 and below-target pace for full year; Onsite sales growth only slightly ahead of company average, a notable deceleration
Shipping costs rising due to Red Sea/Suez Canal disruptions and low Panama Canal water levels; meaningful uptick in container costs observed in recent weeks
2024 P&L faces headwinds from lapping lower 2023 bonus payouts and the end of branch-closure-related occupancy savings, requiring tighter expense discipline

guidance_items.detail: Net capex guided to $225M-$245M in 2024, up from $161M in 2023, reflecting hub automation, Utah DC upgrade, increased FMI spend, and IT investment
Onsite signings target of 375-400 for 2024 reiterated; FMI device signings target of 26,000-28,000 MEUs set for 2024, up from ~24,126 in 2023
Management flagged 2024 P&L headwinds: no repeat of lower bonus payouts and no further branch-closure occupancy savings; business activity entering 2024 described as 'subdued'

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Structural competitive threat to Onsites from e-commerce and competitor in-plant offerings (e.g., MSM)
Supplier consolidation of distributor partners — whether FAST's suppliers are reducing the number of distributors they deal with directly
Impact of severe January weather on early Q1 2024 daily sales rates
